title: Grow your business with Google Play

segments.text: [MUSIC PLAYING]
LIDIA GAYMOND: Hi, everyone.
Thanks for joining us today.
My name is Lidia, and my colleague Phalene
and I are product managers at Google Play.
Together, our teams have been working
on a range of exciting updates designed
to help you grow your businesses and maximize opportunities
for your apps and games.
And today, we're going to give you the inside scoop on all
of them.
There's a lot of features to cover,
so we've grouped them into three main categories.
First, we'll talk about the features that save you time.
We'll show you how to streamline your day-to-day tasks,
from managing custom store listings to running experiments,
so you can focus on building great experiences
and let new AI-powered tools do the rest.
Next, we'll dive into reporting and insights.
These are the tools and features that
show you where to focus your efforts for maximum impact,
like the new reporting tools and Play Console that give you
actionable guidance at exactly the right time in your app's
lifecycle.
And finally, we'll focus on monetization tools,
including the latest ways to boost your bottom line
and reduce friction in the purchase journey.
These updates are designed to work together
to help you grow your business at every stage.
So let's get started with a look at our first category,
saving you time.
Customized store experiences are one of the most effective ways
to engage and attract users, but we know that creating them
can be time consuming.
So with streamlined content creation and testing
for your store listings, so now you
can drive those big results in less time.
We've also made it easier to customize the landing experience
by language, by giving you the ability to import translations
with Gemini.
To submit translations for your listing,
you no longer need to copy paste them.
All you need to provide is a structured document
and we'll pre-populate the store listing forms for you.
And for those of you who are new to custom listings
or just need some fresh ideas, Gemini
can help with recommendations and help
you deploy your new custom listing with just a click.
When Gemini identifies a new growth opportunity for your app,
you'll see it in the recommendations section
on the Grow overview page, along with a custom listing
to capture that opportunity that you can deploy right away.
Last but not least, we've made it easier
to transfer developer account details when
an account owner moves on.
With the new self-serve account owner transfer process,
the current owner of the account can initiate a transfer
to one of their team members.
After proper verifications, you will
be able to complete the process easily using Play Console.
These are just a few examples, but together
all of these improvements add up to a lot less time
spent on admin and a lot more time
to focus on what matters most.
Which brings us to the next batch
of updates, enhanced reporting and insights
to help you figure out where to focus that time,
including helpful guidance and tools to understand and optimize
your performance, connect the dots,
and maximize your ROI on Play.
Starting at the top of the funnel,
we've made significant improvements
to the console's Grow overview page.
This includes new metrics to give you
a consistent and comprehensive view of your growth funnel.
From reach to acquisitions, first opens, engagement,
and retention all in one place.
You'll also be able to see both user and device roll-ups
for many of those metrics.
To give you even more insight, we're
also launching traffic source as a dimension across these metrics
and others, including monetization.
So, for example, if you want to know
what proportion of your engagement
is driven by Explore acquisitions,
or how your user retention compares across traffic sources,
now you can find out with just a few clicks.
But it's not just metrics themselves
we've improved, we're also giving the reporting
API a major upgrade, so you can consume all this data
in a way that works for you.
Until now, the API has only supported Android vitals
metrics, but we're in the process
of adding not only Console growth
and monetization top-line metrics,
but also content performance metrics.
We're also offering an MCP server.
Together, these updates will allow
you to access your Console data programmatically or using
agents, and seamlessly integrate it into your own data sets
and workflows.
As a friendly reminder, access will
depend on specific program requirements and account
eligibility.
Following last year's launch on the Play Console statistics
page, Gemini-powered chat descriptions
have now expanded to the reach and devices, store performance,
and revenue pages.
This brings critical, automated insights
to your most vital charts, helping
you interpret performance data more effectively at a glance.
At the same time, we're also making it easier
to compare and aggregate your data
by standardizing more reports.
Store listing reports will now be
consistent with the way we report on other content,
such as promotional content and YouTube videos.
You will see updates to the way we count visitors,
unique installs and opens, as well as pre-registrations
and respective click through rates,
so you can more easily compare those metrics
across different types of content.
Speaking of clicks and click through rates,
we're also making an important update to the way
we calculate this metric on Play.
As Play Store drives more and more discovery pathways,
we will move to indirect attribution for all store
content, so we can capture more complex user journeys
and provide you with deeper insights.
All of these improvements, from new and enhanced metrics,
to better and more consistent reporting,
will help you get a clearer, more detailed picture
of the value of all your content on Play.
But those aren't the only reports and metrics
we've improved.
So now I'll pass the mic over to Phalene,
who can tell us all about the improvements to our monetization
metrics the team has been working on.

Let's check it out.

that you can take advantage of.

Just click to see the latest insights on your buyers,

Sign up to our early access program today.

To help you reach this incredible audience,

No hunting for codes or waiting for a cash
back for the user and no extra work for you.
Win-win.
We've heard from you that churn can be challenging to solve for,
so we've been looking at multiple ways
to help you with your churn-rate performance.
First, we're streamlining the checkout experience
for one time products and subscriptions,
starting with UPI.
Buyers who use this payment method
will now see a single screen checkout,
so there's less time for user hesitation
when they go to purchase.
This is only the start, and we'll

this year.
To improve your involuntary churn rates,
we've enabled backup payment methods.
Now, if a user has insufficient funds on their primary card,
we can automatically charge the next payment method

We've also rolled out dynamic grace periods for subscriptions.
Using our personalized machine learning models,
this feature turns grace periods into precision tool
for reducing churn.
Instead of a single fixed grace period for everyone,
our system can identify a high-value user
and grant them a longer window to fix
their payment without them losing access
to your app's content.
This intelligently reduces involuntary churn,
all while maintaining a premium user experience.
And next, we want to extend our flexible tooling
to managing your purchases.
We've introduced the dynamic purchases API,
which lets you define all product metadata at runtime
instead of predefining your products on Play Console.
Finally, with more flexible pricing,
you can now set product prices of up to $8,000 US in supported
markets.
For more details, be sure to check out the Play Console Help

Don't forget that the quickest way to get access
to all of these monetization features, including subscription

This also helps you to avoid the functional limitations often
found in middleware SDKs.
To fully unlock the power of Play's billing platform,
including the latest tools and features announced today,
we strongly recommend upgrading to the Play Billing

As a reminder, we will continue to support
each major release of the Play Billing Library for two years.
This means support for version 7 will end in November 2026,
and you'll need to upgrade before you can publish
new versions of your app.
And that's it for our session.
We hope you enjoyed learning about the latest
ways to save time, gain deeper insights,
and boost your bottom line with Play.
We've certainly enjoyed sharing them with you.
Thank you for spending your time with us
and for all of your amazing work with Google Play.
